source: Yaghoobi et al. (2022), PRISMS-Plasticity TM, Fig. 2c (Application 1): deformed pole figures of OFHC copper after uniaxial compression to true strain ~1.0 (Taylor, rate-dependent). Initial texture is RANDOM.
digitized_by: colorbar/pixel mapping of the rendered figure (12 deg central cap, equal-area/Schmidt projection); values approximate (+/- ~0.2 MRD)

111.pattern: ring of intensity at intermediate radius; depleted centre

100.pattern: ring at intermediate radius; depleted centre

110.pattern: strong central maximum = <110> compression fibre aligned with the load axis Z; the primary target feature

match_priority: 2. {100} and {111} central minima with mid-radius rings, peaks ~2.3-2.5
3. overall strong compression fibre (0 to 3.5 MRD scale)
